Reranking with top_n parameter to limit results

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _req = try LiterLlm.rerankRequestFromJson("{\"documents\":[\"Python is a programming language.\",\"Cats are cute animals.\",\"Python was created by Guido van Rossum.\",\"The sun is a star.\"],\"model\":\"rerank-v3.5\",\"query\":\"What is Python?\",\"top_n\":2}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.rerank(req: _req)
debugPrint(result.results())
debugPrint(result.results()[0].relevanceScore())
```
